name: Transit departures
description: Live departures for one Berlin stop (BVG and VBB) with delays. Uses the free v6.bvg.transport.rest API, no key.
author: AmineChr54

stop.label: Stop
stop.hint: Stop name (e.g. Hermannplatz) or a numeric stop id (e.g. 900100003)

lines.label: Lines
lines.hint: Only these lines, comma separated (e.g. U2, M4, 142). Empty shows all

walk.label: Walking time (min)
walk.hint: Departures you can no longer reach are dimmed
